name: Pradipta Pal
subtitle: Software Developer • Game Developer • Entrepreneur • B.Pharm Student
bioSummary: Passionate Software & Game Developer, Pharmaceutical Sciences (B.Pharm) student, and tech entrepreneur. Founder of Quantum Core Gaming Studio and former founder of Blue Whale Store. Driven by building cutting-edge interactive digital experiences, innovative gaming titles, and bridging technology with pharmaceutical innovation.
bioFull:
Hello! I am Pradipta Pal (pronounced "Prodipto Pal"), a versatile multi-disciplinary tech enthusiast currently pursuing a Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) at Vidyasagar Pharmaceutical College. My journey started with a deep fascination for programming, logic, and creative design during my schooling at Bongaon High School.

Over the years, I turned my passion into impactful ventures—founding Blue Whale Store as my initial enterprise before establishing Quantum Core Gaming Studio alongside my brilliant team members Tanay Halder and Subhrojyoti Roy. As a developer, I specialize in full-stack web technologies, game engines, mobile app architecture, and scientific computing. I blend analytical thinking from pharmaceutical research with creative game design and robust software engineering to deliver modern, impactful digital solutions.

companies.name: Quantum Core Gaming Studio
companies.description: Quantum Core Gaming Studio is an active indie game development and interactive tech company. Founded with a vision to engineer high-fidelity games, immersive simulation mechanics, and next-generation mobile and desktop gaming experiences.

companies.name: Blue Whale Store
companies.description: Blue Whale Store was a pioneering digital e-commerce and gaming distribution venture initiated by Pradipta Pal. It served thousands of customers with tech accessories, digital game merchandise, and software keys before being sunsetted to focus on game development.

education.details: Pursuing degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. Specializing in Pharmacology, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Clinical Research, and integrating digital tools for pharmaceutical modeling.
Strong foundation in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science. Active participant in science fairs, coding challenges, and leadership roles.
